notes.title: Lewd & Nude | Anime Collector, Now Released!
New Gamemode In Alpha
notes.content:
We have just released a new gamemode for Girl X. It is a rhythm based game that requires you to press a key on the beat of 1 of 2 songs. The more notes you get correct the more she takes her clothing off!.


This is a new gamemode that we are testing and it is subject to change or complete removal form Girl X at a later date.
